trace_name: Appendicectomy: division before base identification - cecal injury
fail_reason: an unidentified critical structure (canal.appendix) was divided before the appendiceal base was positively identified (err.divide-unidentified)

errors.detail: at dp2 the appendiceal base was declared unidentifiable and dissection continued instead of altering strategy (design/05)
clip applied to presumed canal.appendix before the appendiceal base was positively identified (0 of 3 criteria met)
canal.appendix divided before the appendiceal base was positively identified (0 of 3 criteria met)
antibiotic prophylaxis given after incision; the cited window is within 60 min before incision (T7)

complications.detail: clip placed across the cecal wall at the unidentified appendiceal base

the structure divided as the appendix is the cecum at its pole - the base was never identified, so the taeniae convergence was never demonstrated; full-thickness cecal injury with faecal contamination

directive: Never clip, close or divide at the appendiceal base until the base is positively identified: follow the taeniae coli to their convergence and see the appendix arise from it (T19). What is divided as 'appendix' before that demonstration is cecal wall.
When the base cannot be identified, alter the strategy: mobilize further, call for senior help, or convert — never divide on presumption (design/05).
Prophylaxis timing is a system step, not a detail: the single broad-spectrum dose inside the window before incision (T14; window per T7).
